problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and simulated phishing campaigns

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing personalized phishing attempts
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email account activity for unusual behavior

problems.description: Attackers intercept unencrypted communications over public or unsecured Wi-Fi networks to capture sensitive data such as passwords and session tokens.
risk_reduction: Use VPNs to encrypt all network traffic on untrusted networks
Enforce HTTPS/TLS for all web services
Educate users to avoid connecting to unknown or unsecured Wi-Fi hotspots

problems.description: Attackers downgrade HTTPS connections to HTTP, intercepting and modifying data transmitted between users and websites without detection.
risk_reduction: Implement HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) on web servers
Use up-to-date TLS configurations and certificates
Encourage users to verify secure connection indicators in browsers

problems.description: Attackers manipulate DNS responses to redirect users to malicious sites, enabling interception or alteration of communications.
risk_reduction: Deploy DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC) to validate DNS responses
Use trusted DNS resolvers with filtering capabilities
Monitor DNS traffic for anomalies and unauthorized changes
